title: Merge intervals with validation
description: Implement merge_intervals(intervals). Merge a list of [start, end] interval pairs and return a sorted list of merged [start, end] lists. intervals must be a list (else TypeError); each element must be a list or tuple of length 2 (else TypeError); each endpoint must be an int or float that is not a bool (else TypeError) and finite (NaN or infinity raises ValueError); start must not exceed end (else ValueError). Intervals that overlap or touch (next start <= current end) merge into one. The result is sorted by start and endpoints keep their original numeric values. An empty list returns [].
invariants: Input order does not matter; the output is sorted by start.
Returned intervals are plain two-element lists even when the input pairs were tuples.
bool endpoints are TypeError; NaN/inf endpoints are ValueError; start > end is ValueError.
